title: CyberShield_Blockchain_Event_Schema
description: Defines canonical event structures for Hyperledger Fabric multi-organization intelligence signals.

event_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifying this ledger event. Idempotency key.

event_type.description: Verified signal type emitted by a participating consortium member.

organization_id.description: MSP Identifier of the publishing consortium organization.

opaque_subject_ref.description: HMAC-SHA256 pseudonymized token representing the underlying account or mule entity. Zero raw PII.

cluster_id.description: Target Delhi spatial cluster ID (0 through 40).

district.description: Delhi administrative police district corresponding to cluster.

event_timestamp.description: Physical timestamp when the event actually occurred at the ATM, branch, or field.

submitted_at.description: Timestamp when the transaction was submitted to the Fabric network.

confidence.description: Normalized confidence score of the submitting organization.

verification_status.description: Current verification state of the intelligence signal.

source_reference_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of internal bank transaction log or LEA case diary entry for off-chain audit.

previous_event_ref.description: References previous event_id if this is a SIGNAL_CORRECTION or SIGNAL_REVOKED transaction.

metadata.description: Optional non-sensitive operational tags (e.g. withdrawal amount tier, terminal brand code).
